mechanism: Darunavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase minocycline levels; minocycline can chelate divalent cations and potentially affect darunavir absorption if taken concurrently.
action: Separate administration by 2-3 hours; monitor for minocycline-related adverse effects including dizziness, photosensitivity, and autoimmune phenomena; no dose adjustment typically needed but clinical vigilance warranted.
